by
  cases n with n0,
  { intro h,
    rw [n0, pow_zero, one_pow] at h,
    exact ⟨1, h⟩ }
  { intro h,
    split,
    { rintro ⟨x, hx⟩,
      refine ⟨x, _⟩,
      rw [hx, n.nthRoot_pow_self],
      exact Nat.nthRoot_pow_self_le _ _ },
    { rintro (h1 | h2),
      { exact false.elim h1 },
      { rcases h2 with (h3 | h4),
        { exact false.elim h3 },
        { refine ⟨_, _⟩,
          exact h4,
          exact Nat.nthRoot_pow_self_le _ _ } } } }
